lines.en: label day33:
scene newdespacito1
: So...are you excited, Sensei?! This will be your first time coming with us to karaoke.
lines.zh: : 那个……老师，你兴奋吗？！这可是你第一次跟我们一起来唱卡拉OK。

lines.en: : I don't know if excited is the word, but it beats doing nothing.
lines.zh: : 我不知道能不能用「兴奋」来形容，不过总比干坐着强。

lines.en: : Are you planning on singing?
lines.zh: : 你打算唱吗？

lines.en: : As if you would let him...
lines.zh: : 说得好像你会让他唱似的……

lines.en: : Me? Not a chance. I'm just tagging along to watch.
lines.zh: : 我？不可能。我就是跟着来凑个热闹。

lines.en: : You three can just forget I'm even there if that makes things easier for you.
lines.zh: : 你们三个要是觉得方便，干脆就当我不存在好了。

lines.en: scene newdespacito2
: Absolutely not! I demand that you keep your eyes on me at all times and never even suggest that I forget about you ever again.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行！我要求你时时刻刻都把目光放在我身上，而且以后再也不许说让我把你忘掉这种话。

lines.en: : Besides, you not singing just means that I’ll have to sing hard enough for the two of us.
lines.zh: : 再说了，你不唱，就意味着我得一个人唱出两个人的份。

lines.en: : Why, though? You’re just going to sing the same song you always do...
lines.zh: : 可为什么呢？你不就又要唱你那首老歌吗……

lines.en: scene newdespacito3
: It’s a good song and you know it, Maya!
lines.zh: : 那是首好歌，你心里清楚，Maya！

lines.en: : Heheh...heh...
So, I bet you’re wondering how I wound up in this predicament.
lines.zh: 那么，我猜你一定很好奇我是怎么落到这步田地的。

lines.en: Me too.
lines.zh: 我自己也很好奇。

lines.en: All I know is that I was about to head home and that Ayane wound up grabbing me by the arm and forcibly dragging me to meet up with the other girls.
lines.zh: 我只知道我本来正准备回家，结果 Ayane 一把抓住我的胳膊，硬是把我拖去跟其他女生汇合。

lines.en: I didn't even realize we were going to a karaoke booth until a couple minutes ago.
lines.zh: 直到几分钟前我才发现，我们要去的是卡拉OK包厢。

lines.en: As you may have guessed, Maya didn’t agree to this.
lines.zh: 你大概也猜到了，Maya 并不同意。

lines.en: But seeing as she was promised food, she was unable to refuse. And now their typical friend group has been met with an unhealthy abundance of testosterone out of virtually nowhere.
lines.zh: 但既然答应了管她一顿饭，她就拒绝不了。于是她们那个惯常的小团体，凭空多出了一股含量严重超标的睾酮。

lines.en: Luckily, Ami and Ayane both want me here, so...sucks to be Maya, I guess.
lines.zh: 所幸 Ami 和 Ayane 都想让我来，所以……Maya 就自认倒霉吧，我想。

lines.en: scene newdespacito4
: Anyway...I'm not going to blame you for not wanting to sing, Sensei. I know that's not really your thing.
lines.zh: : 总之……我不会因为你不想唱就怪你啦，老师。我知道那不是你的风格。

lines.en: : Do you know Spanish? Maybe the two of us can do a duet?
lines.zh: : 你会西班牙语吗？也许我们两个可以合唱？

lines.en: : Do...you know Spanish?
lines.zh: : 你……会西班牙语？

lines.en: : Oh, she knows it alright.
lines.zh: : 哦，她可会了。

lines.en: : Can you fake Spanish?
lines.zh: : 那你能不能假装会西班牙语？

lines.en: : Probably not without sounding extremely racist, so I'm going to abstain.
lines.zh: : 大概不行，除非我想听起来像个极端种族主义者，所以我还是免了吧。

lines.en: : This is the best news I have heard all year.
lines.zh: : 这是我今年听到的最好的消息。

lines.en: : Rude.
lines.zh: : 真没礼貌。

lines.en: scene newdespacito5
: Am I wrong, though? Even Ami admitted that this isn't your thing and Ami is literally obsessed with you.
lines.zh: : 可我说错了吗？连 Ami 都承认这不是你的强项，而 Ami 可是字面意义上对你着迷啊。

lines.en: : It's true. She really is.
lines.zh: : 是真的。她确实如此。

lines.en: : Like you're one to talk.
lines.zh: : 你也好意思说别人。

lines.en: : Maya, just because you’re really good at singing doesn’t mean you get to make fun of people who aren’t.
lines.zh: : Maya，你自己唱得好，不代表你就有资格嘲笑唱得不好的人。

lines.en: : Ami, please. Can you really imagine even a halfway decent singing voice coming from him?
lines.zh: : Ami，拜托。你真能想象从他嘴里能发出哪怕勉强算得上好听的声音吗？

lines.en: : I can.
lines.zh: : 我能。

lines.en: : You don't have the right to weigh in. You're just as bad as he probably is.
lines.zh: : 你没有发言权。你大概跟他一样烂。

lines.en: : Sorry, did I hear just now that Maya is actually a good singer?
lines.zh: : 等等，我刚才是不是听见 Maya 其实唱歌很好听？

lines.en: scene newdespacito6
: She's actually really amazing. Most of the time she just eats, though.
lines.zh: : 她其实超厉害的。不过大多数时候她都只是在吃。

lines.en: : I’m much better at that.
lines.zh: : 我更擅长这个。

lines.en: : Sensei, don't listen to what Maya said about me. She knows that I'm the real best singer here.
lines.zh: : 老师，别听 Maya 说我的坏话。她心里清楚这里唱得最好的其实是我。

lines.en: : And as soon as you hear the special song I'm going to dedicate to you today, you'll know it as well.
lines.zh: : 而且等你听到我今天要专门献给你的那首歌，你也就会明白了。

lines.en: scene newdespacito7
: Wait, are you actually going to sing something different today, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 等等，Ayane，你今天真的要唱点不一样的吗？

lines.en: : Huh? Of course not. Do other songs even exist?
lines.zh: : 哈？当然不。这世上难道还有别的歌吗？

lines.en: : You’re...
: You're going to dedicate that song to him?...
lines.zh: : 你要把那首歌献给他？……

lines.en: : Of course. It will make it all the more romantic when we eventually walk down the aisle to it.
lines.zh: : 当然。这样等我们以后踩着它走上红毯的时候，会浪漫得多。

lines.en: scene black
We walk for another ten minutes or so before finally arriving at the karaoke bar.
lines.zh: 我们又走了十分钟左右，终于到了那家卡拉OK。

lines.en: Maya and Ayane go into the room first and I attempt to follow them in, but Ami grabs my sleeve and pulls me aside before I have the chance to...
lines.zh: Maya 和 Ayane 先进了房间，我正要跟进去，可还没来得及，Ami 就一把抓住我的袖子，把我拉到了一边……

lines.en: scene karaoke1
: Okay, so before we go in there, I just want you to know a little about proper karaoke etiquette.
lines.zh: : 好了，进去之前，我想先让你了解一点基本的卡拉OK礼仪。

lines.en: : There’s ‘karaoke etiquette?’ What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 「卡拉OK礼仪」？那又是什么东西？

lines.en: : It means that you’re supposed to stay super-duper positive and cheer for whoever sings even if they’re really, really bad.
lines.zh: : 就是说你必须保持超级——超级积极的态度，不管谁唱都要给人家加油，哪怕他们真的、真的唱得很烂。

lines.en: : Like...really, really bad...
lines.zh: : 比如……真的、真的很烂……

lines.en: : Is Ayane really that terrible?
lines.zh: : Ayane 真有那么糟糕吗？

lines.en: scene karaoke2
: Well, uhh...
lines.zh: : 呃，那个……

lines.en: : No, actually...
lines.zh: : 不，其实……

lines.en: : Her voice is really nice and...she's got good rhythm.
lines.zh: : 她声音很好听，而且……节奏感也不错。

lines.en: : But, uhh...her song choice is...
lines.zh: : 但是，呃……她选的歌嘛……

lines.en: scene karaoke3
: You know what? Why don't we just go in there and...let you see for yourself?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？我们干脆进去……让你自己看好了？

lines.en: scene black
I have a very bad feeling about this...
lines.zh: 我有一种非常不祥的预感……

lines.en: scene karaoke4
: OKAY, BITCHES! THIS ONE IS CALLED DESPACITO AND IT’S DEDICATED TO MY FUTURE HUSBAND AND BEST FRIEND'S UNCLE!
lines.zh: : 好了，贱人们！这首叫 DESPACITO，献给我未来的丈夫，也就是我最好朋友的叔叔！

lines.en: : LET'S FUCKING GO!
lines.zh: : 他妈的，走起！

lines.en: : Do you see what I mean now, Sensei? Do you finally understand?
lines.zh: : 老师，你现在明白我的意思了吧？你终于懂了吧？

lines.en: : Why is this happening?
lines.zh: : 为什么会变成这样？

lines.en: scene karaoke5
: DES-PA-CITO. Quiero respirar tu cuello DESPACITO.
lines.zh: : DES-PA-CITO. Quiero respirar tu cuello DESPACITO.

lines.en: : ¡Deja que te diga cosas al oído!
lines.zh: : ¡Deja que te diga cosas al oído!

lines.en: : ¡Para que te acuerdes si no estás conmigo!
lines.zh: : ¡Para que te acuerdes si no estás conmigo!

lines.en: : Why would you do this to me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要这样对我？

lines.en: : To...spend more time with you?
lines.zh: : 为了……多跟你待一会儿？

lines.en: scene karaoke6
: DES-PA-CITO.
lines.zh: : DES-PA-CITO.

lines.en: scene karaoke8
Ami takes a seat beside Maya, who is obviously significantly more prepared for this than either of us.
lines.zh: Ami 在 Maya 旁边坐下，而 Maya 显然比我们俩都准备得充分得多。

lines.en: : You guys really let her do this every time you come here?
lines.zh: : 你们每次来都真由着她这么干？

lines.en: : Hahahah...Yeah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……是啊……

lines.en: : She’s already selected it like four more times after this.
lines.zh: : 这首歌之后她又点了差不多四次。

lines.en: : We’ve found that it’s best to just let her get it out of her system as soon as possible.
lines.zh: : 我们发现，最好还是让她尽快把这股劲儿发泄完。

lines.en: : ¡DES-PA-CITO! Quiero respirar tu cuello DESPACITO.
lines.zh: : ¡DES-PA-CITO! Quiero respirar tu cuello DESPACITO.

lines.en: : Her Spanish is surprisingly good.
lines.zh: : 她西班牙语好得惊人。

lines.en: scene karaoke7
: Right? I think her butler must have taught her because our school doesn't even offer a Spanish class.
lines.zh: : 对吧？我觉得一定是她的管家教的，因为我们[school]根本就没开西班牙语课。

lines.en: scene karaoke9
: Can we order food now? I’m really hungry and you promised me dinner.
lines.zh: : 现在能点吃的了吗？我真的好饿，你答应过管我晚饭的。

lines.en: : Huh? Oh, right. What do you want?
lines.zh: : 哈？哦，对。你想吃什么？

lines.en: : What? You're going to have to speak up. I'm currently protecting myself from bodily harm.
lines.zh: : 什么？你得大声点。我现在正在保护自己免受身体伤害。

lines.en: : Oh, forget it. I'm just going to make you come with me anyway.
lines.zh: : 哦，算了。反正我也要硬拉着你跟我一起去。

lines.en: : What? I can't hear you.
lines.zh: : 什么？我听不见。

lines.en: scene karaoke10
: Sensei, do you want anything? It’s on me today.
lines.zh: : 老师，你要吃点什么吗？今天我请客。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’m supposed to let my [niece] buy me dinner.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我不该让我的[niece]给我买晚饭。

lines.en: : But you let me make you dinner all the time. I don't see how this is that much different.
lines.zh: : 可你不是老让我给你做晚饭吗。我不觉得这有多大区别。

lines.en: : Seriously, what are you saying?
lines.zh: : 说真的，你在说什么啊？

lines.en: : You know what? Good point. Just get me whatever you're having.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？说得有道理。就给我来份跟你一样的吧。

lines.en: scene karaoke10r
: Roger that. The phone in this room is broken and Maya orders way too much anyway, so...watch over Ayane for me while I'm gone?
lines.zh: : 收到。这房间的电话坏了，而且 Maya 反正也会点一大堆，所以……我不在的时候，你帮我看着点 Ayane 行吗？

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: scene karaoke11
: ¡DESSS-PAAA-CITO!
lines.zh: : ¡DESSS-PAAA-CITO!

lines.en: : Sorry, Sensei! I love you!
lines.zh: : 对不起，老师！我爱你！

lines.en: : Please hang in there!
lines.zh: : 请坚持住！

lines.en: : What? What are we hanging on? Ami, I really can't hear-
lines.zh: : 什么？我们要坚持什么？Ami，我真的听不——

lines.en: : TAKE OFF THE HEADPHONES THEN, MAYA! COME ON!
lines.zh: : 那就把耳机摘了啊，MAYA！拜托！

lines.en: scene black
: THANK YOU, LADIES AND GENTLEMEN. THIS NEXT SONG IS A BRAND NEW ONE.
lines.zh: : 谢谢各位女士先生。下一首是全新的一首。

lines.en: : IT’S CALLED “DESPACITO” AND IT'S ALL ABOUT HOW MUCH I LOVE SENSEI!
lines.zh: : 它叫「DESPACITO」，讲的是我有多爱老师！

lines.en: : ONE, TWO, THREE, FOUR!
lines.zh: : 一、二、三、四！

lines.en: : DESPAAAA-
lines.zh: : DESPAAAA-

lines.en: Ami and Maya disappear for what feels like years.
lines.zh: Ami 和 Maya 消失了，感觉像是过了好几年。

lines.en: There is no one left in this world that I can trust.
lines.zh: 这世上已经没有我能信任的人了。

lines.en: I fall victim to the darkness and lose myself.
lines.zh: 我败给了黑暗，迷失了自我。

lines.en: Despacito consumes me whole.
lines.zh: Despacito 将我彻底吞噬。

$ ami_love += 1

$ maya_love += 1
Ami's affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]！

lines.zh: Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]！

lines.zh: Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]！
